reza: hi all 44b started yesterday. quick orientation Qs: where do i drop quick how-to questions vs bugs vs "hey welcome" intros? also my phone is getting a ton of CI DMs, any quick fixes?
olivia (People Ops): welcome reza! short cheat: intros go in #new-hires or #random (if informal). How-to or usage q's -> #help. Bugs that affect others -> open a thread in the repo's channel (or #support if user-facing). Sensitive HR/pay issues -> DM People Ops.
diego (Eng): for dev workflow: PR review requests belong in your team's channel (e.g., #eng-platform) with a link to the PR and a short summary. For investigating runtime errors post the minimal repro in the root message (code block) and keep follow-ups in-thread. Example we like: ```Service: model-router
Env: staging
Cmd: ./start.sh
Error: connection refused (stack trace...)```
sam (DevEx): CI noise: two quick options: 1) In App Settings > Notifications, set "Only @mentions" for CI channels. 2) Use `/ci digest on` to get a single nightly digest instead of per-build DMs. Also try muting channels you don't want pings from, but keep threads active for things you care about.
reza: nice. what about emoji reactions? sometimes i'm unsure what :eyes: vs :thumbsup: means here.
olivia (People Ops): shorthand we use: :eyes: = looking/acknowledged, :thumbsup: = go-ahead/approve, :white_check_mark: = resolved. If you need a formal approval wait for an explicit comment.
diego (Eng): small note on threads: if a discussion drifts into a spec/design, please create a new thread and link the original message. That keeps channels scannable. Long decisions should land in the relevant repo issue or design doc and ping the channel with the summary.
reminder-bot: Onboarding Tip Day 2: Set up SSH keys, install dev certs, and join team meetings. Reply `skip` to silence these for today.
ci-bot: [ci] build #3120 passed (linux/integration) - triggered by reza
reza: perfect, thanks. i'll set notifications to only mentions and use `/ci digest on`. i'll post reproducible snippets in #help and keep threads tidy. cheers! :raised_hands:
